'''House Pilor''' was one of seventeen [[Noble/Legends|noble]] houses that settled in the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region after the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] implemented the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]]. House Pilor became based in the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], where they established the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pirralor]] as their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. The family had a reputation for being dissolute and irresponsible.
